before: A move made in the room had no range marker items: compose drew its range round its wrappers, so a later move or typing at the end of its words went after the range live, and inside it after a fold and in the editor alone. A file's move without range markers read the same way.
after: Every pending move has range marker items, made by the move's change or by the load for a file's move without markers, with the w:id, name and mark compose wrote before, so placement is the same live, after a fold and in the editor alone.
reason: Change messages, the change log, checkpoints and the Yjs format do not change: the markers come from the same change on every copy, and a checkpoint writes the markers it wrote before. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
